description: The line plot compares the Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) of different query selection strategies used in training and inference for Dense Retrieval with Document Expansion (DPR). The x-axis represents the number of queries used during inference, ranging from 0 to 10, with a tick label interval of 2. The y-axis measures the MRR, ranging from 33.0 to 36.5, with a tick label interval of 0.5. The plot includes six lines, each representing a different strategy: DPR without query (black solid line), DPR with gold (green solid line), DPR with top-1 (blue solid line), DPR with bottom-1 (purple solid line), DPR with random (yellow solid line), and DPR with curriculum (red solid line). The black line remains relatively flat, indicating a consistent MRR across the number of queries used. The green line shows a steady increase in MRR as the number of queries increases. The blue line also increases but at a slower rate than the green line. The purple line remains relatively flat, similar to the black line. The yellow line shows a gradual increase in MRR, while the red line shows a more pronounced increase, especially after the 6th query.
